title: The Voice from the Red River

scenes.narration: If you ever hear your mother calling your name from a river at dusk, do not answer. Especially if your mother is dead.
scenes.bg_prompt: wide calm river at dusk, reeds on the bank, distant village

scenes.narration: I'm Tam. My grandmother told me this story, and she swore every word of it was true.
scenes.bg_prompt: old bamboo village path at dusk, wooden houses

scenes.narration: In Vietnam we call it ma da: the ghost of someone who drowned. It cannot move on until it pulls another person under to take its place.
scenes.bg_prompt: dark river at night under a full moon, fog over the water

scenes.narration: So it waits. Ten years, twenty years. It is very, very patient.
scenes.bg_prompt: dark river at night under a full moon, fog over the water

scenes.narration: One summer evening, a boy named Tu swam out alone. Then something ice cold grabbed his ankle.
scenes.bg_prompt: wide calm river at dusk, reeds on the bank, distant village

scenes.narration: Tu survived. But every evening at dusk, he still hears his mother calling him from the river. See you in the next story.
scenes.bg_prompt: old bamboo village path at dusk, wooden houses
